name: Modge
summary: Desktop time tracking and workforce analytics for remote and hybrid teams: automatic hours, app and URL classification, shift adherence, leave, payroll-ready timesheets and Stripe invoicing. 14-day trial, no card.
best_for: desk-bound remote or hybrid teams of a few to a few hundred people who want time tracking, app classification, shift adherence, leave and payroll-ready timesheets in one seat priced between $4 and $7 a month, and who are happy to run screenshots as an opt-in rather than a default
skip_if: you need SSO or a SOC 2 report today, both are marked soon; your people work in the field, since the agent is desktop-only with no mobile or GPS on the page; or your security team will not accept a compliance claim without a document
honest_knock: The numbers on Modge's own pages do not agree with each other. The homepage says trusted by 1,000+ teams, the affiliate page says 1,800+ teams, the pricing page says over 2,000 users; the pricing page also shows three star ratings, 4.6 from 1,500 reviews, 4.8 from 2,000 and 4.2 from 800, without naming a single platform they come from. None of that touches the product, but it is the kind of copy a buyer should not repeat in a business case. What does touch the product is the comparison table: SSO through SAML 2.0, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 9001 are all marked soon, and HIPAA compliant appears with no report behind it. If your security review needs a document today, there is none to hand over. The desktop agent is macOS and Windows only, and the pricing page mentions no mobile app or GPS, so field teams are out of scope.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-03 and re-verified 2026-10-16 on modge.com/pricing, both billing toggles and the comparison table; every amount unchanged) Per-seat plans with a full-feature 14-day trial. Our sign-up on 19 November 2026 asked for a card at step 5 of 5 before the app opened, with Due today $0.00. Basic is $5 per seat per month billed monthly or $4 billed annually: app and URL tracking with AI productivity classification, workforce dashboards, automatic time tracking with optional screenshots, timesheets, approvals and payroll exports, invoice creation, email and chat support. Pro is $7 monthly or $5.50 annually and adds shifts, scheduling and adherence, leave, breaks and overtime, client billing through Stripe, on-demand screenshots with 12-month retention, and custom roles, teams and project budgets. Premium, marked popular, is $9 monthly or $7 annually and adds automated project and task time tracking, workflow analysis, suspicious-activity and mouse-jiggler detection, burnout-risk and profitability insights, contract signing, 24-month screenshot retention and a dedicated account manager. Enterprise is custom, on annual billing with volume pricing, custom retention, customised onboarding and an SLA. Two add-ons are priced per seat: More Screenshots at $2 a month lifts capture from 18 to 60 an hour on Basic, Pro and Premium; Extended Data Retention at $2 a month or $1.67 annually keeps records for six years on every tier. The comparison table lists screenshot retention as 3 months on Basic, 12 on Pro and 24 on Premium, and marks SSO (SAML 2.0), SOC 2 Type II and ISO 9001 as soon. The FAQ's blanket 'Annual billing saves 22% over monthly' holds only for Premium ($9 to $7, 22.2%); Basic saves 20% ($5 to $4) and Pro 21.4% ($7 to $5.50), as the plan cards themselves say. Re-read 20 November 2026 on modge.com/pricing: every amount unchanged (Basic $5/$4, Pro $7/$5.50, Premium $9/$7 per seat a month, both add-ons $2 a seat, retention $1.67 on annual billing). The page contradicts itself on certification: the comparison table still marks SSO (SAML 2.0), SOC 2 Type II and ISO 9001 as soon, while the FAQ on the same page says Modge is SOC 2 Type II certified, ISO 9001 certified and HIPAA compliant. We treat those certifications as not confirmed until Modge publishes a report or certificate.

compare_with.name: Hubstaff
compare_with.why: The obvious comparison. Hubstaff's annual column starts at $4.99 a seat with a two-seat minimum and its monthly column at $7; Modge starts at $4 annual or $5 monthly with no minimum on the page. Hubstaff has the longer record, a mobile app with GPS and a far larger integration list; Modge's pitch is shift adherence, leave policies and Stripe invoicing built into a cheaper seat, with screenshots you can switch off (in our trial they were on by default). Pick Hubstaff for field teams, Modge for desk-bound teams that also need rotas.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Modge in the 14-day Basic trial that we started with our card at the last sign-up step. A project, 8 hours of manual time and a report took about 10 minutes, once the owner was added as a member of the project. Screenshots were on by default. Cancelling took two clicks in the app and keeps access until December 3, 2026. Account and start: we created the account and started the 14-day trial with his own card at step 5 of the sign-up; the earlier attempts of the same day stopped at that card step. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 19 November 2026 from about 15:05 to 15:26 CET, in its own tab. The interface was in English. After the card the sign-up goes on with Step 1/3 Create Your First Project, Step 2/3 Working Hours and Step 3/3 Bring Your Team; nobody was invited. Core action, hours from a project to a report: the project Test Project was created in step 1/3. Timesheets, Add Time first gave Please select a project, because the project had 0 members; after adding the owner as a member, Time added successfully, a row of 8 hours (09:00 to 17:00) on Test Project. Reports, Tracked Hours showed Test Project 8:00 on 19 November and Total Hours 8:00. Time to the first line of hours in a report: about 10 minutes in about 14 steps, 4 of them for the missing project member. The timesheet banner said This member has no pay period configured. Time entries are recorded but will not be grouped into timesheets. Settings: Monitoring, Screenshots showed Screenshot Capture Enabled, Blur Screenshots Clear and an interval of 300 seconds on a new account. Classification had no apps, because the desktop tracker was not installed. The Download Client button was not clicked. Clients and invoices: a client Test Client BV with a test e-mail address was added. A one-time draft invoice, Test consulting, 3 hours at $50.00 an hour, $150.00, was saved as INV-000001 with status Draft; it was not finalised, sent or downloaded. Before the first invoice the client needed Set up billing, with Stripe card and Stripe ACH ticked by default. Plans and trial: Plan and Billing shows Basic, 14 days trial left, Next payment date: Dec 3, 2026, $5.00 per user a month, 1 user, and a first invoice of $0.00, Paid. Edit Plan shows Basic $5.00, Pro $7.00 and Premium $9.00 a month, an Annual cycle at $3.00 a user a month ($36.00 billed annually), and the More Screenshots add-on at $2.00 a seat a month. In step 3/3 the sign-up said Modge Pro, while billing says Basic. Checkout: the card step was done by us before the session and was not seen in this session. Cancelling, done the same day: Organization, Manage plan, bottom of the page, Cancel Subscription, then a dialog Are you sure you want to cancel your subscription? Your plan will remain active until December 3, 2026, and Yes, Cancel. No reason form, no retention offer and no password. After reload: Your subscription is scheduled to cancel on December 3, 2026, with Undo Cancellation. Not tested: inviting team members, the desktop tracker and everything it fills (app and URL tracking, screenshots, the productivity score, Real-Time and Timeline), an hours-based invoice, finalising or sending an invoice, client payments through Stripe, shifts, leave, export and a mobile app. Clean up: the account, Test Project, the client Test Client BV, 8 hours of manual time and the draft invoice stay; the subscription is cancelled and stays usable until December 3, 2026. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Manual time could not be added until the owner was made a member of the project; the error only said Please select a project. Screenshots are on by default with no blur. The sign-up said Modge Pro while billing says Basic.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Modge in the 14-day Basic trial that we started with our card at the last sign-up step. A project, 8 hours of manual time and a report took about 10 minutes, once the owner was added as a member of the project. Screenshots were on by default. Cancelling took two clicks in the app and keeps access until December 3, 2026. Account and start: we created the account and started the 14-day trial with his own card at step 5 of the sign-up; the earlier attempts of the same day stopped at that card step. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 19 November 2026 from about 15:05 to 15:26 CET, in its own tab. The interface was in English. After the card the sign-up goes on with Step 1/3 Create Your First Project, Step 2/3 Working Hours and Step 3/3 Bring Your Team; nobody was invited. Core action, hours from a project to a report: the project Test Project was created in step 1/3. Timesheets, Add Time first gave Please select a project, because the project had 0 members; after adding the owner as a member, Time added successfully, a row of 8 hours (09:00 to 17:00) on Test Project. Reports, Tracked Hours showed Test Project 8:00 on 19 November and Total Hours 8:00. Time to the first line of hours in a report: about 10 minutes in about 14 steps, 4 of them for the missing project member. The timesheet banner said This member has no pay period configured. Time entries are recorded but will not be grouped into timesheets. Settings: Monitoring, Screenshots showed Screenshot Capture Enabled, Blur Screenshots Clear and an interval of 300 seconds on a new account. Classification had no apps, because the desktop tracker was not installed. The Download Client button was not clicked. Clients and invoices: a client Test Client BV with a test e-mail address was added. A one-time draft invoice, Test consulting, 3 hours at $50.00 an hour, $150.00, was saved as INV-000001 with status Draft; it was not finalised, sent or downloaded. Before the first invoice the client needed Set up billing, with Stripe card and Stripe ACH ticked by default. Plans and trial: Plan and Billing shows Basic, 14 days trial left, Next payment date: Dec 3, 2026, $5.00 per user a month, 1 user, and a first invoice of $0.00, Paid. Edit Plan shows Basic $5.00, Pro $7.00 and Premium $9.00 a month, an Annual cycle at $3.00 a user a month ($36.00 billed annually), and the More Screenshots add-on at $2.00 a seat a month. In step 3/3 the sign-up said Modge Pro, while billing says Basic. Checkout: the card step was done by us before the session and was not seen in this session. Cancelling, done the same day: Organization, Manage plan, bottom of the page, Cancel Subscription, then a dialog Are you sure you want to cancel your subscription? Your plan will remain active until December 3, 2026, and Yes, Cancel. No reason form, no retention offer and no password. After reload: Your subscription is scheduled to cancel on December 3, 2026, with Undo Cancellation. Not tested: inviting team members, the desktop tracker and everything it fills (app and URL tracking, screenshots, the productivity score, Real-Time and Timeline), an hours-based invoice, finalising or sending an invoice, client payments through Stripe, shifts, leave, export and a mobile app. Clean up: the account, Test Project, the client Test Client BV, 8 hours of manual time and the draft invoice stay; the subscription is cancelled and stays usable until December 3, 2026. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Manual time could not be added until the owner was made a member of the project; the error only said Please select a project. Screenshots are on by default with no blur. The sign-up said Modge Pro while billing says Basic.

open_questions.question: Are screenshots deleted after 3, 12 or 24 months depending on the plan, or kept for as long as the subscription runs?
Does Modge hold a SOC 2 Type II report today?
Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?

Our price check could not put a number on this part of the cost: Add-ons per seat (More Screenshots $2 a month, Extended Data Retention $2 a month or $1.67 annually) are optional and not included. Can you publish the price or the rule?
